name: Kerne USD
oneLiner: kUSD is Kerne Protocol's Base-native synthetic dollar, live at genesis scale and currently backed 1:1 by USDC while its hedge vault is rebuilt.
collateral: Currently backed 1:1 by USDC split across three on-chain Peg Stability Module contracts (1,113.885006 USDC against 1,112.707154 kUSD outstanding as of 2026-07-23): the live mint PSM (0xaBDE1138), retired mint PSM (0x07eBb486), and original redeem-reserve PSM (0xFf3025ec). By design kUSD is a delta-neutral synthetic dollar: a WETH vault leg paired with an equal short on Hyperliquid (Lido/wstETH staking long plus perpetual funding), but that vault leg is in a disclosed degraded state pending a v2 redeploy and is excluded from published reserves, so live backing is presently the combined USDC PSM reserve only.
pegMechanism: 1:1 mint and redemption against USDC through on-chain Peg Stability Modules: minting routes through the live KUSDPSM at 0xaBDE1138 (10 bps base fee, 10,000,000 USDC cap), while the retired mint PSM at 0x07eBb486 and original PSM at 0xFf3025ec remain redemption reserves. Only 0xaBDE1138 holds the kUSD MINTER_ROLE. The intended steady-state peg pairs the PSM with a delta-neutral basis trade (wstETH staking long, Hyperliquid perpetual short) so holders carry no directional ETH exposure; that hedge leg is currently degraded and excluded.

mintAuthority.summary: Anyone can mint kUSD permissionlessly by depositing USDC 1:1 into the on-chain Peg Stability Module (10 bps fee, 10,000,000 USDC cap); the PSM holds the kUSD MINTER_ROLE. On 2026-08-06 DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE over kUSD and all three PSM contracts moved from the 2-of-3 Gnosis Safe to an OpenZeppelin TimelockController with a 48 hour minimum delay, so parameter and role changes on those four contracts now wait 48 hours in public. The Safe holds PROPOSER, EXECUTOR and CANCELLER on that timelock and no longer holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE on them directly. Two carve-outs matter: a PauseGuardian contract can pause the PSMs instantly, outside the delay, and the staking wrapper skUSD, which holds roughly 88 percent of kUSD supply, is NOT behind the timelock and remains under instant Safe admin.

controls.label: Kerne live KUSDPSM (kUSD MINTER_ROLE)
controls.capDescription: USDC to kUSD mint runs through the PSM at 1:1 with a 10 bps fee and a 10,000,000 USDC cap; the PSM holds the kUSD MINTER_ROLE.
controls.evidence: At Base block 49003308, kUSD hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0xaBDE1138) returned true while the same read returned false for 0x07eBb486 and 0xFf3025ec. The live PSM returned mintingEnabled=true, paused=false, supportedStables(USDC)=true, swapFees(USDC)=10, and stableCaps(USDC)=10000000000000 (10,000,000 USDC).

controls.label: Kerne admin Gnosis Safe (2-of-3, timelock proposer/executor/canceller)
controls.evidence: Read on-chain at Base block 49656821: the Safe is version 1.4.1 with 3 owners, threshold 2, zero enabled modules and no guard set (the guard storage slot is zero). Its DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE over kUSD and the three PSMs was given up in the 2026-08-06 handover batch (0xed24d495..., block 49623130): hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, Safe) returned false on kUSD 0x5C2EfdF0 and on 0xaBDE1138, 0x07eBb486 and 0xFf3025ec, while the same reads against the TimelockController returned true. The Safe retains PROPOSER, EXECUTOR and CANCELLER on the timelock, so it still initiates every privileged change, but on those four contracts it can no longer execute one inside 48 hours. It does still hold DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE directly and instantly on skUSD 0x96F5102C.

controls.label: Kerne TimelockController (48h delay, DEFAULT_ADMIN on kUSD and all three PSMs)
controls.capDescription: Raising the PSM stable cap, granting or revoking kUSD MINTER_ROLE, and every other DEFAULT_ADMIN action on kUSD and the three PSMs must be scheduled through this timelock and cannot execute for at least 48 hours. This answers the prior open question on whether the live KUSDPSM cap can be raised only after a timelock: as of 2026-08-06 it can not be raised any faster.
controls.evidence: Read on-chain at Base block 49656821: getMinDelay() returns 172800, a 48 hour minimum delay. hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0x36A14976) returned true on kUSD 0x5C2EfdF0 and on all three PSMs (0xaBDE1138, 0x07eBb486, 0xFf3025ec); the same read for the Safe returned false on all four. The timelock is self-administered, meaning its own DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE is held by the contract itself rather than by the Safe, so a canceller seat cannot be stripped in a single transaction. Source verified on BaseScan 2026-08-08 as an OpenZeppelin TimelockController (solc 0.8.24).

controls.label: Kerne PauseGuardian (instant PSM pause, outside the 48h delay)
controls.capDescription: Cannot mint, cannot raise a cap and cannot change any parameter. It expresses exactly one call, pause(module), against the three PSMs, and only the Safe can invoke it. It exists so that halting never has to wait 48 hours.
controls.evidence: Read on-chain at Base block 49656821: hasRole(MANAGER_ROLE, 0xC47adaf5) returned true on all three PSMs (0xaBDE1138, 0x07eBb486, 0xFf3025ec). Source verified on BaseScan 2026-08-08. This is a deliberate carve-out from the timelock and should be read as one: the emergency stop is instant, everything else on those contracts is delayed.

review.evidence: Pharos independently read the live contracts at Base block 49003308: 0xaBDE1138 held kUSD MINTER_ROLE with minting enabled, while 0x07eBb486 and 0xFf3025ec did not hold the role and retained their USDC redemption reserves. The 2-of-3 Gnosis Safe 0x52d3E450 remains described as DEFAULT_ADMIN with authority to grant or revoke the minter role and change PSM parameters; its owner set, modules, and guard were not re-read in this review.
unresolvedQuestions: skUSD 0x96F5102C is NOT behind the 48 hour timelock: hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, Safe) returned true at Base block 49656821, and skUSD holds roughly 88 percent of kUSD supply. Decide whether that instant-admin surface should be scored separately from the timelocked kUSD and PSM surface.
Confirm whether the PROPOSER, EXECUTOR and CANCELLER seats the Safe holds on the timelock can themselves be changed without going through the timelock.

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: kUSD is backed 1:1 by USDC held in the on-chain Peg Stability Module, so its redemption value inherits Circle USDC freeze and seizure exposure through the reserve asset. The kUSD token's own admin freeze surface was not independently re-read on-chain in this submission.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Per the live /api/stats endpoint kUSD reserves are 100% USDC in the PSM, so freeze exposure is inherited from the USDC reserve asset; kUSD's own token freeze surface is unreviewed in this submission.
blacklistabilityReview.reviewer: Kerne Protocol submitter; Pharos pre-launch intake

reserves.name: USDC held 1:1 in the on-chain Peg Stability Module

notices.title: Genesis beta; pending active runtime price coverage
notices.message: kUSD is live on Base but genesis-scale: circulating supply is 1,112.707154 kUSD (roughly 1,113 USD) as of 2026-07-23. DefiLlama now indexes Kerne USD supply as stablecoin id 402, but the row still has no usable price and CoinGecko does not resolve a Kerne USD coin, so Pharos keeps kUSD in the pre-launch/pre-active tracker until both active runtime gates are satisfied.

notices.title: Hedge vault degraded; backing is currently 100% USDC
notices.message: The v1 WETH vault and its Hyperliquid short hedge are in a disclosed degraded state and are excluded from published reserves pending a v2 redeploy, so live backing is presently the USDC Peg Stability Module reserve 1:1. The delta-neutral hedge is operated off-chain by a single operator. A first external audit by Hexens (final report 2026-07-31: 10 findings, 0 critical, 2 high; 8 fixed, 2 acknowledged, all in KerneVault) is published at kerne.fi/security/audits; the live KerneVault still runs pre-audit bytecode with deposits closed pending remediated redeploy. Disambiguation: this is Kerne Protocol's Base-native kUSD (0x5c2efdf0...), independent of Kernel Protocol's kUSD on Ethereum mainnet and KernelDAO's KUSD on BNB Chain.

launchPhaseDetail: kUSD v2 is live on Base (first PSM mint 2026-05-14), but Pharos treats it as pre-active until a usable runtime price path exists. The protocol is in a genesis, capacity-capped phase: supply is about 1,113 USD, DefiLlama stablecoin id 402 exposes supply with price=null, CoinGecko does not resolve a Kerne USD coin, and the v1 WETH/Hyperliquid hedge vault leg is disclosed-degraded and excluded from reserves so kUSD is currently 100% USDC-backed through three PSM reserves. Staking wrapper skUSD (ERC-4626, 0x96F5102C15b839757f811A98CEc3725Ac21DfA14) is deployed with a published live APY but near-zero third-party stake. The previous skUSD (0xdEd74F7E) is retired. Admin over kUSD and all three PSMs moved to a 48 hour TimelockController on 2026-08-06, proposed and executed by the 2-of-3 Gnosis Safe, which still holds instant admin over skUSD; hourly signed proof of reserves is published at kerne.fi/verify.

milestones.title: Admin over kUSD and all three PSMs moved behind a 48 hour timelock
milestones.description: DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE on kUSD and the live, retired and redeem-reserve PSMs was transferred from the 2-of-3 Gnosis Safe to an OpenZeppelin TimelockController (0x36A14976, getMinDelay 172800) in one atomic batch at block 49623130. The Safe keeps PROPOSER, EXECUTOR and CANCELLER. A PauseGuardian keeps emergency pause instant. skUSD is not covered and remains under instant Safe admin.
